grading_system.evidence: Students must earn a minimum of 23 credits to receive a Lake Region diploma. ... Receiving a Lake Region diploma is contingent upon preparation, submission, presentation and approval of an LRfolio.

schedule.evidence: Students in grades 9 to 12 are required to carry a minimum of 2 classes per term to be eligible for participation in extracurricular activities (p.15). The course summary lists credit 'Per Sem./Yr.' (p.8); other passages refer to quarters/terms and semesters. The catalog does not state the number of classes in a full course load or a block pattern.

credit_definition.text: Semester courses carry 1/2 credit and year-long courses carry 1 credit (Course Summary column 'Credit Per Sem./Yr.'); some courses carry 1/4 credit.
credit_definition.evidence: Course Summary for 2026-2027 ... Credit Per Sem./Yr. ... Fitness/Weightlifting 1/2 Credit; Yearbook Class- 1 credit (must complete full year)

course_load.min_courses_or_credits: minimum 2 classes per term for extracurricular eligibility; grade-level minimums of 5 3/4 (sophomore), 11 1/2 (junior), 17 1/4 (senior) credits earned; full course of study expected
course_load.evidence: Students in grades 9 to 12 are required to carry a minimum of 2 classes per term to be eligible for participation in extracurricular activities.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Catalog states requirements directly in credits (23 total, including 4.5 elective credits and 0.5 community service credit). No conversion needed.

notes: Local requirements beyond credits: LRfolio (four-year portfolio, presentation and approval) is a final graduation requirement in addition to passing courses (p.3); a Composition course is required to graduate (p.36); Global Citizenship course (course listed p.12; the front matter's 3.5 social studies credits are stated without naming it, so its requirement status is taken from the Phase 2 extraction and not verified in the front matter);Health Education semester course in grade 9 (p.53); Technology Applications 0.5 credit includes 0.25 for LRfolio presentation (p.2-3); 40 hours community service (up to 1 additional credit). Personalized Learning Plan developed with advisor (p.3). Catalog also refers to quarter/term deadlines (p.5, p.29) alongside semester courses; terms_per_year recorded as 2 because credit is listed per semester. Some courses carry 1/4 credit (p.14). Schedule structure and courses per term in a full load are not stated.
